Directed by Sharon HawthorneJune 6 - 28, 2025While her immediate peaceful environment is being destroyed by real estate developers, Grace, an independent backwoods 90-year-old, forms an uninvited but life-changing friendship with Glorie, an emotionally burdened inexperienced Hospice volunteer determined to do good - like it or not. The play is full of deprecating funny moments and lively conversation. Checks for donations or subscriptions can be mailed to:Curtain Call TheatrePO Box 588Guerneville, CA
